$comment: Emotions for lib/emotions.mjs (author's prompt #15; changed by eye in prompt #20: focused removed, happy tilts 6 degrees). Each state is a partial pose made only of what this face has: brows shown or hidden and their height, eyes open or closed, the five mouths, head tilt and shift. Chosen values, labelled so. Every state stays inside rig.json limits together with liveness (largest liveness |tilt| 0.68 degrees, |y| 6.64 px).
transitionWhy: Chosen: 8 frames (0.27 s at 30 fps) is quick enough to land on a word and slow enough not to snap.
easing: smootherstep 6x^5 - 15x^4 + 10x^3: no trigonometry, zero speed at both ends.
discreteRule: eyes, mouth and whether the brows are shown switch at the middle of a transition; brow height, tilt and shift ease. Hidden brows count as browsRestDy when easing their height.

happy.why: brows lifted part way over the logo's own smile (the rest mouth); a small tilt and lift add lightness
happy.changed: first proposed with the wide mouth; on the first emotions sheet the hollow wide mouth read as gritted teeth, not as a grin, so happy keeps the closed smile
happy.chosenByEye: tilt 6 degrees instead of 2: chosen by eye by the author (prompt #20), after looking at the emotions sheet, where happy and focused read as the same face

surprised.why: brows at their highest and the round mouth are the clearest surprise this face has; the head pulls up a little

sleepy.why: closed eyes, no brows and a drooping, tilted head; the only state that closes the eyes on purpose

speech: While Ping speaks, lip sync owns the mouth: the speech mouth is combined after the emotion, on every frame from the first to the last letter of an utterance (rest frames of closures included). Outside speech the emotion's mouth shows. Brows, eyes and head stay with the emotion during speech.
demoWhy: Chosen: 10 s at 30 fps, each state held for 2 s after its 8-frame transition, ending back at neutral. Since focused was removed (prompt #20; decided by Claude) its mark is simply gone, so surprised holds from frame 90 to frame 210.

focused.why: chosen by eye by the author (prompt #20): on the emotions sheet happy and focused read as the same face, so focused is removed
